This is not a hypothetical risk – it's a concrete threat. For instance, in Nigeria, popular payment platforms can suspend accounts without warning, leaving creators without access to their hard-earned income. This is the infrastructure problem COREMERCH aims to solve, and it's not a workaround – it's a replacement for the entire payment infrastructure stack.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) deploys a basic digital commerce stack in 48 hours, complete with GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments. This stack allows creators to load up to three products, with automatic on-chain crypto payment verification and instant delivery. It's a solid foundation for small-scale creators looking to dip their toes into sovereign commerce. On the other hand, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a more comprehensive solution, deploying a stack that includes Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This stack supports up to five products, with additional features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing. It's ideal for creators who need more advanced infrastructure and flexibility.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

COREMERCH's solution is built on the principle of no-KYC, allowing creators to operate without the need for Know Your Customer verification. This means that creators can sell to restricted countries without worrying about their accounts being frozen or funds being withheld. In contrast, traditional payment platforms often impose strict KYC requirements, which can limit creators' access to certain markets. With COREMERCH, creators can focus on building their business without worrying about the infrastructure risks that come with it.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments, the payment processor used by COREMERCH, offers instant payment verification and delivery. This means that creators can receive payments within minutes of a sale, without the need for intermediaries. The fees are also minimal, at 0.5% per transaction, with recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON offering even lower fees. In contrast, traditional payment platforms often charge higher fees and take longer to process payments.
COREMERCH's solution is not a workaround – it's a replacement for the entire payment infrastructure stack.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the key benefits of COREMERCH's solution is that creators own and control their infrastructure, with no reliance on third-party platforms. This means that creators have complete control over their data, including customer lists, order history, and product files. Additionally, the automation features offered by COREMERCH's solution allow creators to focus on building their business, without the need for manual intervention. Finally, the delivery features ensure that products are delivered instantly, without the need for intermediaries.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The practical steps to infrastructure sovereignty start with choosing where your data lives. In Stack 01, orders are stored in Google Sheets — your Google account, your data, exportable at any time. In Stack 02, orders are stored in Supabase — your Supabase account, PostgreSQL database, full SQL access, exportable at any time. Product files in Stack 01 live in Google Drive — your Google account, 15GB free, shared via time-limited links generated by Apps Script. In Stack 02, files live in Cloudflare R2 — your Cloudflare account, 10GB free, zero egress fees, presigned URLs with configurable expiry.
What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators?

The question of whether to build on platforms or build sovereign infrastructure comes down to a single risk calculation: what happens when the platform changes its terms, restricts your market, or suspends your account? For creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other restricted markets, that question has already been answered — the platform already said no. Sovereign infrastructure is the primary architecture for creators who cannot afford to depend on platforms that have already demonstrated they will exclude your market without notice, without recourse, and without apology.
Creators own and control their infrastructure, with no reliance on third-party platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For creators who want to take their infrastructure to the next level, COREMERCH offers the Complete Builder Kit ($197) – a comprehensive package that includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates. With this kit, creators can build, deploy, and scale their sovereign digital commerce stack with ease. And if you're just getting started, be sure to check out COREMERCH's products page at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information on pricing and packages.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack with COREMERCH, follow these steps: First, choose the right architecture for your needs – either Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). Next, deploy the stack using GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments. Configure the automation features to streamline your business operations. Finally, integrate the delivery features to ensure seamless product delivery. With COREMERCH, you can have your infrastructure up and running in no time.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is sovereign commerce infrastructure?

Sovereign commerce infrastructure refers to the underlying technology stack that powers a digital commerce business. It includes the payment processors, automation tools, and delivery mechanisms that enable creators to sell their products and services online. With COREMERCH, creators can own and control their infrastructure, without relying on third-party platforms.
Why is no-KYC important for restricted countries?

No-KYC is essential for restricted countries because it allows creators to operate without the need for Know Your Customer verification. This means that creators can sell to restricted countries without worrying about their accounts being frozen or funds being withheld.
How do I deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack?

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, choose the right architecture for your needs, deploy the stack using GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments, configure the automation features, and integrate the delivery features. COREMERCH offers detailed documentation and support to help you get started.
What are the fees associated with COREMERCH?
NOWPayments, the payment processor used by COREMERCH, charges a 0.5% fee per transaction. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON offer even lower fees.
Can I use COREMERCH if I'm already selling on other platforms?

Yes, you can use COREMERCH in conjunction with other platforms. However, keep in mind that COREMERCH's solution is designed to provide a sovereign commerce infrastructure, so you may need to integrate your existing platforms with COREMERCH's solution.
